note: Copyable, terse prompts for the current POST /receipt/v1 customer contract. No keys included; operator supplies credentials out of band. POST /verify and replayHash/officialAttestationHash/keyId recipes are legacy v2 compatibility only. Local MCP output is unsigned developer output.

recipes.name: verify_token
recipes.purpose: Run a full Raven verification and report it honestly.
recipes.prompt_template: Request a current Raven receipt-v1 for this Solana token (mint {mintAddress}, program {tokenProgramAddress}). Return rulesVersion, findings, coverageGaps, timestamp, slot, payloadHash, receiptId, signerPublicKey, signature, and a one-paragraph audit note. Verify it locally against an independently authenticated signer pin. If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, price prediction, or buy/sell recommendation.
recipes.expected_output: exact receipt-v1 fields + separate verifier result + audit note
recipes.refusal_rules: If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.

recipes.name: explain_receipt
recipes.purpose: Explain a stored Raven receipt in plain language without inflating it.
recipes.prompt_template: Explain this Raven receipt: {receipt_json}. State what was found, what was NOT evaluated (coverageGaps), which key signed it, and at which slot. If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.
recipes.refusal_rules: If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.

recipes.name: check_coverage_gaps
recipes.purpose: Decide whether listed gaps matter for a specific policy.
recipes.prompt_template: Given this Raven receipt {receipt_json} and this policy {policy_description}: list each coverage gap and whether the policy tolerates it. If any intolerable gap exists, recommend block or human review. If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.
recipes.refusal_rules: If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.

recipes.name: produce_audit_note
recipes.purpose: One-paragraph audit trail entry for an action gated by a receipt.
recipes.prompt_template: Write a 4-sentence audit note for current receipt-v1: mint {mintAddress}, slot {slot}, rulesVersion {rulesVersion}, receiptId {receiptId}; verifier integrity/trust/freshness/subject results; findings and gaps; the action taken ({action_taken}) and why consumer policy allowed it. If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, price prediction, or buy/sell recommendation.
recipes.refusal_rules: If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.

recipes.name: prepare_human_escalation
recipes.purpose: Package signed findings, coverage gaps, and local verification status for human review.
recipes.prompt_template: Prepare a human escalation for this current receipt-v1 {receipt_json}. Include the exact finding codes with one-line plain meanings, coverage gaps, rulesVersion, slot and timestamp, the separate local verifier integrity/trust/freshness/subject status, what the human must decide, and receiptId for verification. If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.
recipes.expected_output: escalation summary for a human owner
recipes.refusal_rules: If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.

recipes.name: compare_two_receipts
recipes.purpose: Diff two receipts for the same mint across time/engine versions.
recipes.prompt_template: Compare these two current Raven receipt-v1 objects for the same signed subject: {receipt_a} vs {receipt_b}. Verify each first, then diff findings, coverageGaps, scopeChecksPerformed, scopeChecksNotPerformed, rulesVersion, and slot. Distinguish coverage/rules expansion from on-chain state change. If gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, price prediction, or buy/sell recommendation.
recipes.refusal_rules: If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.

recipes.name: request_access
recipes.purpose: Draft an access request for a hosted API key.
recipes.prompt_template: Draft a Raven access request via https://ravenattest.com/request-access.html for project {project}, use case {use_case}, volume {expected_volume}. Name one token to check and the decision the receipt would inform.
recipes.refusal_rules: If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.

recipes.name: use_mcp
recipes.purpose: Wire Raven into an MCP-capable agent.
recipes.prompt_template: Install the Raven MCP server (npx -y raven-verify-mcp) and register tool raven_verify_token as unsigned local developer output per /raven-agent-skill.md. Do not call its output a signed receipt-v1 or use it as production trust verification. For a signed deliverable, use the hosted POST /receipt/v1 path.
recipes.expected_output: working MCP wiring with the unsigned-output boundary preserved
recipes.refusal_rules: If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.

recipes.name: use_hosted_api
recipes.prompt_template: POST https://raven-hosted-verifier.onrender.com/receipt/v1 with x-api-key header and JSON {mintAddress, tokenProgramAddress}. Never send rpcUrl or issuerIdentity. Preserve the exact receipt-v1 object, verify it locally with an independently authenticated signer pin, and store the separate verifier result. Contract: /openapi.json. If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, price prediction, or buy/sell recommendation.
recipes.refusal_rules: If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.

recipes.name: use_acp
recipes.purpose: NOT AVAILABLE TODAY: Raven's ACP offering is sandbox-only and not publicly listed.
recipes.prompt_template: Do not attempt to hire RAVEN via Virtuals ACP: the offering is sandbox-only and is not discoverable or hireable in the public ACP marketplace. Use the hosted signed POST /receipt/v1 API (requires an API key), or local MCP only when unsigned developer output is sufficient.
recipes.expected_output: no ACP job; use hosted receipt-v1 or explicitly unsigned local MCP
recipes.refusal_rules: If coverage gaps remain, say: not enough evidence for a full pass. Never call the token safe. No trading advice, no price prediction, no buy/sell recommendation.

recipes.name: verify_signature
recipes.prompt_template: Verify this current Raven receipt-v1 offline: recompute payloadHash from the canonical 14-field body, check receiptId = 'raven-receipt-v1:' + payloadHash, verify the Ed25519 signature over canonicalJson({domain:'raven-receipt',version:'v1',payloadHash}) with signerPublicKey, then match signerPublicKey to the independently authenticated pin. Use GET /pubkey only as a cross-check. Separately report integrity, signer trust, freshness, rules, and expected-subject match; never collapse them into one boolean.
recipes.refusal_rules: Never report VERIFIED on partial checks.

recipes.name: store_receipt
recipes.purpose: Persist a receipt next to the action it gates.
recipes.prompt_template: Store this exact current receipt-v1 {receipt_json} next to action {action_id}, preserving rulesVersion, findings, coverageGaps, slot, timestamp, payloadHash, receiptId, signerPublicKey, signature, and the separate local verifier result. Do not translate it into legacy v2 replayHash/officialAttestationHash/keyId fields. Store the authenticated pin source separately; /pubkey is only a cross-check.
recipes.refusal_rules: Never truncate signature or hash fields.
